name: LUM-201

lead: LUM-201 is the development name for ibutamoren (MK-0677), a daily oral drug that stimulates the body's own growth hormone release. Physique users discuss it as a pill-form route to higher GH and IGF-1, aiming for more muscle and less fat.

It activates the GH secretagogue (ghrelin-type) receptor, prompting pulsatile GH release and raising IGF-1. It is being developed as an alternative to injections in children with growth hormone deficiency; Phase 2 trials reported growth responses in some children and a Phase 3 trial is under way. No study has examined it for appearance in healthy people.

paras: In trials it is a daily oral drug for children with diagnosed GH deficiency, with a pretreatment test proposed to identify who is likely to respond. In physique circles it is discussed as a pill alternative to GH injections.

It is investigational and not approved by any regulator. Safety data come from pediatric trials, with long-term safety extensions registered. Data in healthy adults seeking looks outcomes are not available.

angle.text: LUM-201 is ibutamoren (MK-0677), an oral GH secretagogue that physique users discuss as a pill-form route to higher GH and IGF-1, meaning more muscle and less fat. Trials so far are in children with GH deficiency.

lead: LUM-201 (ibutamoren, formerly MK-0677) is an orally administered growth hormone secretagogue receptor agonist under clinical development for pediatric growth hormone deficiency (PGHD) [1]. It is developed as a daily oral alternative to injected growth hormone.

Phase 2 trials in children with idiopathic PGHD have examined growth responses, and researchers have proposed a pretreatment test to identify children with enough residual hypothalamic-pituitary function to respond [2][3][4]. A Phase 3 placebo-controlled trial is registered and recruiting [5][6]. It is not approved by any regulator.
No published study has tested LUM-201 for appearance outcomes in healthy people.

paras: LUM-201 acts at the GH secretagogue (ghrelin-type) receptor to stimulate pulsatile GH release. In a comparison of 68 children in a PGHD trial, a single dose elicited greater GH responses than standard diagnostic stimuli such as arginine and glucagon [1][7].
A pediatric capsule formulation was reported to show similar pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic responses to the tablet [8].

Phase 2 trials include OraGrowtH210 (n=104, completed), OraGrowtH212 (n=24) and the extension and safety studies OraGrowtH211 and OraGrowtH213 [9][10][11][12]. Researchers reported that the growth response in children with moderate GHD depended on the pattern of GH pulsatility induced by LUM-201, and that a predictive enrichment marker could identify responsive children [2][13][3][14]. Interim analyses reported dose responsiveness in acute GH response, IGF-1 and annualized height velocity [15][4].

A Phase 3 trial against placebo in treatment-naive children is registered and recruiting, with a long-term safety extension planned [5][6][16]. Small Phase 2 studies in fatty liver disease (ibutamoren, n=12) and, planned, with semaglutide in older adults with obesity are also registered [17][18].

timeline.event: Predictive enrichment marker paper and OraGrowtH212 start [2][11].
Phase 3 trial in children registered as recruiting [6].
